summary.text: John Block is a Republican state representative from New Mexico who has represented House District 51 since January 1, 2023, and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He is the founder and editor of the Piñon Post.

paragraphs.text: Block was born in New Mexico and earned an associate degree from Santa Fe Community College in 2016, a bachelor's degree from Rutgers University in 2019 and a graduate degree from Eastern New Mexico University in 2020.

In a 2022 Ballotpedia survey, he described himself as a native New Mexican and the founder and editor of the Piñon Post, and said he had worked as a staffer at the state Legislature and as a manager at Americans United for Life.
He listed protecting families and life, and supporting the military and law enforcement, among his key campaign messages in that survey.
